description: This Kotlin source file defines classes and functions for accessing and searching the call log on Android devices. It includes data classes for call log records and search requests, an interface for data source abstraction, a concrete implementation for system call logs with permission checks, and a handler class to process search requests and output results in JSON format.

classes.name: CallLogRecord
classes.description: Represents a single call log entry with number, cached name, date, duration, and type.

classes.name: CallLogSearchRequest
classes.description: Encapsulates parameters for searching call logs, including filters like name, number, date range, duration, and type.

classes.name: CallLogDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods to check call log read permissions and to perform searches.

classes.name: SystemCallLogDataSource
classes.description: Concrete implementation of CallLogDataSource that accesses Android's system call logs with permission handling.

classes.name: CallLogHandler
classes.description: Main handler class that processes search requests for call logs, formats results into JSON, and manages permissions.

methods.name: hasReadPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to read the call log.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs the call log search based on provided filters and returns a list of CallLogRecord objects.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch
methods.description: Processes incoming JSON search parameters, checks permissions, performs search, and returns JSON result wrapped in GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into CallLogSearchRequest object, with default values and validation.

methods.name: callLogJson
methods.description: Converts a CallLogRecord object into a JSON object for output.
